title: Find The Count Of Numbers Which Are Not Special
description:
A positive integer is special when it has exactly two positive proper divisors (divisors other than itself). Given an inclusive range `[l, r]`, return the number of integers in that range that are not special.

## Examples

```text
Input: l = 5, r = 7
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: l = 4, r = 16
Output: 11
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= l <= r <= 10^9`
